# Resonance ePublisher

> AI-powered platform that turns topics, manuscripts, PDFs, research, and recordings into researched, narrated audiovisual eBooks.

Resonance ePublisher is currently available at no charge under the Resonance Free Access Promotion while real provider, generation, storage, and support costs are measured.

## Promotion access

- No payment, checkout, credit pack, or subscription is required during the promotion.
- Full product capability is available after sign-in so projects can persist and usage can be measured.
- Future pricing has not been established and will require a new governed release after costing is validated.

- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point.
- [About](/about): Research, storyboard, visual book, narration, and export workflow.
- [Free access](/pricing): Current promotion status.
- [Contact](/contact): Product support.
